app.title: Zroom
app.description: A collector community where you display what you own in a virtual room, look inside other people's rooms, and turn any piece into a listing as it is.

myRoom.emptyRoomDesc: Add your first item and it will appear here
myRoom.emptyRecordsDesc: Write down the story behind your things — it becomes proof later

category.pickDesc: We will focus on the category you pick. You can change it anytime above
category.label: Category

item.partOf: This item is a part of —

item.ownerOnlyHint: Where, when and how much you paid are never shown to others.

item.privateNow: Currently private. Only you can see it
item.privateOnSaleWarn: This item is on sale. Making it private removes it from the market. Continue?
item.routineHint: The order is the routine. Add exercises and rests, and set reps per set.
item.inRoutinesHint: Exercises inside a routine are not shown separately in the room.
item.routineRequested: Requested “{name}”. We’ll let you know once it’s approved.
item.routineInactive: This exercise was retired by the team. It stays in your routine.

diary.bodyPlaceholder: What happened with this item today?
diary.plainTextHint: Plain text only. Links are not auto-linked.
diary.errEmpty: Add some text or at least one photo

sanction.blocked1: Browse the feed, search, market or other rooms
sanction.blocked2: Create or edit items and entries

externalLink.title: You're leaving this service

report.noAutoHide: Reporting does not hide the content right away. A moderator reviews it first.

sell.errUrlScheme: Must start with http or https
sell.errNeedsPublic: Agree to make it public to list it
sell.markSoldConfirm: Marking it sold moves it to “items you've let go” and removes it from codex owner counts. You can undo this.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.roomNameHint: It's fine if someone else uses the same name.
settings.goPrivateWarn: Going private removes {count} listings from the market.
settings.goPublicWarn: Going public puts {count} listings back on the market. Price and link stay as they were.
settings.languageHint: Only the interface changes. Your entries, room name, about and item details stay as written.
settings.blocksHint: Blocking hides both rooms, items, entries and listings from each other. They are not told.

level.dayBoundary: The day resets in your own time zone.
